symbol.title: Empty archive
symbol.desc: A small navy backpack with a luggage tag, surrounded by two tilted polaroid frames waiting to be filled.

symbol.title: No live offers
symbol.desc: A small storefront with a striped awning, a single hanging open sign, and an empty sidewalk.

symbol.title: No feedback yet
symbol.desc: A large rounded speech bubble with a single short line drawn inside, hinting at the first comment.

symbol.title: Location unavailable
symbol.desc: A meandering trail of footsteps that fades into a question mark.

symbol.title: No routes available
symbol.desc: A folded paper map with creases, a dotted route, and a small question mark hovering above.

symbol.title: Welcome to Walking Explorers
symbol.desc: A small figure walking along a path at golden hour, with the New York City skyline glowing behind them.

symbol.title: First walk complete
symbol.desc: A curving footstep trail ending in a small four-pointed sparkle.

symbol.title: First spot captured
symbol.desc: A camera with a fresh polaroid emerging from the slot, set against a small brownstone facade with a tree.

symbol.title: Share a walk
symbol.desc: Two small figures on either side of the frame, connected by a curving dashed route that becomes an envelope mid-air.

symbol.title: Camera access
symbol.desc: A hand holding up a small camera, with a soft glow indicating capture.

symbol.title: Loop complete
symbol.desc: A celebratory scene: the New York skyline glows in golden hour, a small figure stands at the start of a circular trail of footsteps that closes back on itself, with sparkles in the sky.

symbol.title: Footprint pattern
symbol.desc: A repeating, low-contrast pattern of footprints used as decoration behind statistics.

symbol.title: Share card background
symbol.desc: A landscape skyline silhouette at golden hour with sparkles, sized for an auto-generated share card.

symbol.title: First Loop badge
symbol.desc: A circular navy badge with a gold star at the center sitting above a small skyline silhouette.

symbol.title: Neighborhood Explorer badge
symbol.desc: A circular badge containing a stylized borough outline with five pin markers indicating walked routes.

symbol.title: Photo Collector badge
symbol.desc: A circular badge containing a tilted stack of three polaroid photos.

symbol.title: Night Walker badge
symbol.desc: A circular badge with a crescent moon, a few stars, and a tiny skyline silhouette at the bottom.

symbol.title: Founding Walker badge
symbol.desc: A circular badge with laurel branches around the number 100, signifying one of the first hundred users.
